'''Star Tours Flight 108''' was the designation of a flight offered to passengers by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency around the time of the [[Battle of Death Star III]]. It was scheduled to depart for [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] from Gate 9 at the time, but was delayed.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|Tokyo only}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This flight was listed on a video screen found exclusively in the queue of [[Tokyo Disneyland]]'s version of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction.<ref name="YouTube ST queue">{{YouTube|video=bTHFWK8G_7A|text=TDL : Star Tours Queue Line No. 1|channel=@couperin9|name=couperin9}}</ref>
